summary: For legacy accounts without SCA, find the AAP Pool ID with `subscription-manager list --available --all` and attach it with `subscription-manager attach --pool`; never use MCT4022 as the pool_id.
questions: How do I attach an AAP subscription pool on a legacy account?
How do I find the AAP Pool ID?
Why does subscription attach fail with MCT4022?

answer_card.title: Attach a pool (legacy, non-SCA)
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
sudo subscription-manager list --available --all | grep -A 30 "Ansible Automation Platform"
sudo subscription-manager attach --pool=<pool_id>
```
Do **not** use `MCT4022` as the `pool_id`.
